# Spell Modifiers

Give your spells the limits and effects vanilla spells have: a slow cast, no casting at sea, Burn Forest for whoever knows it. Each modifier goes on its own line in a [spell](spells.md). Spells that make the army of whoever knows them heal faster are on [Army Healing](army-healing.md).

### slowcast { #slowcast .command data-toc-label="slowcast" data-added="1.2" }

Makes the spell take 2 combat rounds to cast.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@slowcast
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    slowcast
    ```

### notsea { #notsea .command data-toc-label="notsea" data-added="1.2" }

Stops units casting the spell at sea.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@notsea
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    notsea
    ```

### notunderground { #notunderground .command data-toc-label="notunderground" data-added="1.2" }

Stops units casting the spell underground.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@notunderground
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    notunderground
    ```

### prioritylearn { #prioritylearn .command data-toc-label="prioritylearn" data-added="1.2" }

Makes a unit that starts with spells learn this one before the others of its path and level.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@prioritylearn
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    prioritylearn
    ```

### burnforest { #burnforest .command data-toc-label="burnforest" data-added="1.2" }

Gives the caster Burn Forest while it knows the spell. Inside a spell only; elsewhere `burnforest` is the game's monster ability.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@burnforest
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    burnforest
    ```

### Example spells { #example }

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@newspell "Fire of Udun"
    #!@path "Pyromancy"
    #!@level 3
    #!@weapon 20 "Fireball"
    #!@slowcast
    #!@notsea
    #!@notunderground
    #!@burnforest

    #!@newspell "Athelas"
    #!@path "White Magic"
    #!@level 1
    #!@weapon 4 "Heal"
    #!@prioritylearn
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newspell "Fire of Udun"
    path "Pyromancy"
    level 3
    weapon 20 "Fireball"
    slowcast
    notsea
    notunderground
    burnforest

    newspell "Athelas"
    path "White Magic"
    level 1
    weapon 4 "Heal"
    prioritylearn
    ```
